topic: Whitebeard lending Oden to Roger is why Roger reached Laugh Tale
title: Whitebeard Lent Roger The Key To Laugh Tale
description: Roger begged Whitebeard to let Oden sail with him, and that single loan may be why the Pirate King reached Laugh Tale. Here's the detail most fans forget. Was Oden the real key to the Road Poneglyphs?
comment: Did Roger need Oden to read the Road Poneglyphs, or could he have done it alone? Pick one.

lines.text: Whitebeard is the reason Roger reached Laugh Tale.

lines.text: Not his fleet. Not his Haki. One man he lent away.

lines.text: Roger needed someone who could read the Road Poneglyphs, so he begged Whitebeard to let Oden join him.

shot.fallback: pirate bowing before a giant captain

lines.text: Oden agreed, and joined the Roger Pirates.
Here's the detail most people forget.
At Skypiea, Oden deciphered the Poneglyph by the Golden Belfry Bell, and wrote Roger's own message beside it.
